changelog:
This one installs normally — no uninstall needed.

WHAT'S NEW
Game Lounge, all new: Blackjack with split hands and side bets, Casino Hold'em, Roulette, Slots with Snowfall bonuses, Plinko, Dice Lounge, Video Poker, TV Trivia and the Daily Spin. Play for Snow Coins and climb the leaderboard.
Posts from Snow Media, in Support: the Community tab is now Posts. Every email we send out lands there too, dated and marked New until you open it, and opens full screen at TV size. Links in a post become a code you scan with your phone. A count shows on the Support card when there is a new post; switch the heads-up off under Settings → UI.
Plex, redone: a menu down the left for Home, your libraries and their rows. Whatever poster you land on is described above the rows — cover art, rating, year, runtime, genres, a summary and how much is left — with slimmer rows that fit more on screen.
Live TV, three ways: Classic, Compact and Grid layouts under Player Settings → Appearance. OK on a channel previews it, OK again goes full screen.
Content bar, built for you: what you were watching, your live channels with what's on now, and Plex picks based on what you watch.
Dashboard fits on one screen; a Large option under Settings → UI for anyone who wants it bigger.
Plex: hold OK on a library to hide it.
The Player's second card now says Plex, with Movies & Series underneath.
Device Cleaner, in Support: clears every app's cache, closes background apps, removes leftover installer files, and lists apps nobody opens.
Admin dashboard works with the remote: every section scrolls and every button can be reached.
Trials and purchases made on the TV now create your Snow Media customer record and website account on their own.
Your login email now arrives after a trial or purchase.
Snow Gems can be bought from the Dashboard: pick a pack, scan the code with your phone, pay there, and the gems land on your account by themselves.
Premium AI: Chat and Image Gen can switch to the top models for Snow Gems, or stay free. Compare both on one prompt, once, for nothing.
The Player counts your service: how many channels, movies and series, shown next to All and on the account screen.
Live TV: every account you've signed in shows in one list, each service under its own name, and a group folds up so you can get to the other one fast.
Hide Categories under Player Settings: switch off the categories you never open.
Favorites fix themselves when a service changes a channel's link, and holding OK on a favorite offers Refresh channel link.

FIXES
Player sign-in: the keyboard's Next, Done or Enter, and the remote's Play, move from Username to Password and on to Sign In.
Support and Device Cleaner: a bright gold highlight on every button, row-by-row movement, and lists that no longer jolt when they scroll.
Home: the Dashboard button's highlight is gold instead of black.
Device Cleaner on Fire TV: no Accessibility switch needed. Leftover files and background apps clear in one press; app caches open on Fire TV's own app page, one app at a time.
Plex: any active Live TV line connects, nothing has to be added on file first.
The Movies tutorial no longer tells you to send a code.
Pressing up at the Player's top menu stays at the top instead of dropping back into the list.
releaseNotes: Version 1.7.3 brings the all-new Game Lounge and Posts from Snow Media into Support, redoes Plex and Live TV with slimmer, roomier layouts, adds the Device Cleaner to Support, lets you buy Snow Gems from the TV, adds Premium AI, makes the Admin dashboard work with the remote, and creates your customer record and website account automatically after a TV trial or purchase. Installs normally — no reinstall.
